response.justification: Bogdan is a deeply experienced generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node, distributed and low-latency systems, cloud/Kubernetes/AWS CDK, open-source leadership and teaching). However, the role's core bar — 8+ years building production-grade AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; his AI exposure appears limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), no LLM evaluation/observability work, and no explicit enterprise customer-facing consulting or discovery-leadership experience. He could be a credible fit for a platform/agent-infrastructure engineering role, but as a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI Engineer he would be a significant stretch. Worth a screening conversation mainly to probe the depth of the recent MCP/agent work.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; staff-level scope and mentoring/teaching track record
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience, directly relevant to the key tech stack
Strong TypeScript/Node, cloud (AWS CDK, Kubernetes), CI/CD and testing-craftsmanship background
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-related work vs. the 8+ years of AI solution delivery required
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent frameworks
Python absent from skills; limited demonstrated customer-facing/consulting technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG / vector DB / multi-agent expertise
Strong senior engineering breadth and MCP/agent tooling exposure
